# TrackWarranty

> TrackWarranty is a free warranty tracker and bill keeper app. Snap a bill or receipt, and it records the product, store, purchase date and warranty length, reminds you 30, 7 and 1 day before the warranty expires, and builds a one-tap claim kit (invoice, serial number, dates, brand support). It works offline, saves data on the phone first, needs no sign-up, and supports any country and currency. Available on Android (Google Play: app.trackwarranty); iOS coming soon. TrackWarranty for Brands helps consumer electronics and appliance brands register buyers with a QR code on the box and launch and track their own warranty programs.

Key facts:
- Price: free
- Platforms: Android (live), iOS (coming soon)
- Core features: bill/receipt capture with automatic detection, warranty expiry reminders (30/7/1 days), one-tap claim kit, full-receipt search (every word on every bill, works offline), shared household vault for family, export to CSV / PDF report / backup ZIP, optional Google sign-in for backup and sync
- Privacy: offline-first; data is stored on the device first and synced only if the user signs in; no ads; data is not sold
- Coverage: any country, any currency, local date formats
- Support: vidya@repliantai.com, +91 62074 66460
